decision.reasoning_trace: I initially filtered through the list to remove accessories like cases, charging cables, and non-speaker items like the bluetooth hat. This left several high-quality portable speakers. I included the JBL Go 3 and JBL Clip 3 in my consideration set due to their superior 4.7 ratings. I also added the EWA A106 Pro and EDUPLINK as they represent the best value-for-money options with massive review volumes. The XENEO X21 was included for its versatility (FM radio and SD slot). I ultimately decided on the JBL Go 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_129) because it offers a perfect balance of portability, brand reliability, and IP67 dust/water resistance for outdoor use, which is a significant upgrade over the basic budget models.
